title: Kuda Berhenti di Rumah Itu
genre: Lombok Sasak cilokaq pop (gambus, suling and rebana)
subject: A cidomo horse-cart driver in Mataram whose horse Si Hitam stops dead at one gate every morning because the girl inside feeds him sugarcane, until the driver tells his passenger to get out because they have arrived
caption: Lombok Sasak cilokaq pop, a fast festive dance song. A gambus lute plays the bouncing main melody with quick plucked ornaments, a suling bamboo flute answers in the gaps, rebana frame drums and a tambourine drive a lively rolling rhythm, a simple bass guitar holds the root notes, no drum kit. Bright room sound, short plate reverb. A male lead sings in a light cheerful tenor with a teasing lift at line ends. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 124 BPM, D minor. Bouncy, teasing mood. No electronic beats, no autotune, no rap, no distorted guitar, no synth pads.
lyrics:
[Intro - gambus, suling, rebana]

[Verse 1]
Pagi di Mataram, lonceng cidomo berbunyi
Kudaku si Hitam jalannya gagah
Tapi lewat gang ketiga kakinya berhenti
Tak mau maju, ia menoleh ke pagar

[Pre-Chorus]
Penumpang menggerutu, aku pura-pura marah
Padahal aku tahu, kau juga tahu

[Chorus]
Di rumah itu ada tebu dan senyum
Si Hitam tak mau pergi, aku pun tidak
Tarik tali kekang, ia tarik hatiku
Berhenti dulu, berhenti dulu, Dinda

[Verse 2]
Dinda keluar membawa tebu sebatang
Kuda makan, aku yang malu
Besok pagi lewat sini lagi ya
Kudaku mengangguk, aku ikut mengangguk

[Chorus]
Di rumah itu ada tebu dan senyum
Hari ini aku lewat dengan sengaja
Tarik tali kekang, ia tarik hatiku
Tuan penumpang, turun saja, kita sudah sampai

[Outro - gambus, rebana]
Berhenti dulu, berhenti dulu
Si Hitam dan aku sudah sampai
